```json
{"claims":[{"claim_text":"The United States and its allies depend on oil from the Middle East.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Republicans prefer an America that is far less dependent on foreign crude oil.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"A Republican president will not be so tolerant if OPEC colludes to drive up the world price of oil, as it has done this past year.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The United States should restore its underlying good and cooperative relations with the oil-exporting nations, most importantly Saudi Arabia, as well as with other moderate Arab governments.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The nations of Africa have endured tremendous burdens of war, poverty, disease, and bad government.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Freedom is gaining ground in South Africa, Nigeria, Niger, Mozambique, and Mauritius.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Democracy can help ensure that the interests of the people are elevated above the preoccupations and self-enrichment of corrupt elites.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Some of Africa's developing countries are turning to private markets, building middle classes, and evolving toward more representative forms of government that respect individual liberties.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"Such transformation is not simple.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"A Republican president and Congress will work to encourage these efforts through closer economic integration, security assistance, and support for freedom.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"Republicans will replace process with outcome and rhetoric with substance.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[4]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
